channel.description: Latest articles from The Bear - South Bend 103.9 (1039thebear.com)

item.title: Real Rocker of the Day: Rob Delich of Elkhart- Real Rocker #177 - 103.9 The Bear - Real Rock
item.description: Rob Del “The Bristol Prodigy” from Elkhart is today’s featured rocker. He works at Tredit Tire, has been making music for over 15 years, and is currently working on his fifth album, Upper Echelon. Raised on his parents’ vinyl collection, Rob still cranks Ozzy, Priest, and Crüe on The Bear while building his epic Star Wars collection. Congrats, Rob – Real Rocker of the Day #177!

item.title: Real Rocker of the Day: Kristen Gillison of Granger - Real Rocker #178 - 103.9 The Bear - Real Rock
item.description: Kristen Gillison from Gragner is a Medical Assistant and a lifelong rock fan who keeps The Bear cranked whenever she can. As the oldest of seven siblings, she balances a busy life with reading, hanging out with her dogs, binge-watching favorite shows, and blasting bands like Disturbed, Shinedown, Linkin Park, and Papa Roach. Congrats, Kristen – Real Rocker of the Day #178!

item.title: Real Rocker of the Day: Jake Wainman of Niles - Real Rocker #179 - 103.9 The Bear - Real Rock
item.description: Jake Wainman from Niles is a freelance writer and lifelong rocker who grew up blasting ‘80s rock thanks to his parents’ car stereo. When he’s not writing, he’s diving into video games, horror movies, anime, or exploring nature and spooky places. Jake rocks out to bands like The Offspring, Slipknot, Korn, Static-X, and Mudvayne and loves hearing Jason Lee &amp; Kluck, Morgan Reed, and Drew Cage on The Bear. Congrats, Jake – Real Rocker of the Day #179!

item.title: Real Rocker of the Day: Brian Rohde of South Bend - Real Rocker #180 - 103.9 The Bear - Real Rock
item.description: Brian Rohde from South Bend works at Four Winds Casino and has been a rock fan since he was a kid. When he’s not working, he’s usually gaming, drawing, or singing along to bands like Linkin Park and Hollywood Undead. Brian says he loves The Bear for the rock and the awesome giveaways the station brings to the community. Congrats, Brian – Real Rocker of the Day #180!

item.title: Real Rocker of the Day: Joshua Kovacs of Mishawaka - Real Rocker #181 - 103.9 The Bear - Real Rock
item.description: Joshua Kovacs from Mishawaka has been rocking with 103.9 The Bear since he was a kid riding to school with his mom—and now he’s still tuned in on the drive to Purdue Polytechnic High School. A fan of bands like Linkin Park, Breaking Benjamin, and Foo Fighters, Joshua also enjoys bowling, gaming, and life with his fiancé and two cats. Congrats, Joshua – Real Rocker of the Day #181!

item.title: Real Rocker of the Day: Derek Goodsell of Warsaw - Real Rocker #182 - 103.9 The Bear - Real Rock
item.description: Derek Goodsell from Warsaw has been rocking with 103.9 The Bear for more than 25 years and gives a big shoutout to the crew at Brinkley RV. When he’s not listening to Jason Lee and Kluck on his morning drive, he’s spending time with his fiancé, two daughters, and their hounds, visiting zoos or planning trips to the Smoky Mountains. Congrats, Derek – Real Rocker of the Day #182!

item.title: Real Rocker of the Day: Ben Coetzee of South Africa - Real Rocker #183 - 103.9 The Bear - Real Rock
item.description: Ben Coetzee from South Africa cranks 103.9 The Bear from halfway across the world, refusing to settle for anything but real rock. A design draughtsman by day and aspiring internet radio host by night, Ben shares the Bear with his wife and two boys while rocking out to Metallica, Limp Bizkit, and more. Congrats, Ben – Real Rocker of the Day #183!

item.title: Real Rocker of the Day: Ray Grummell of Mishawaka - Real Rocker #184 - 103.9 The Bear - Real Rock
item.description: Ray Grummell from Mishawaka has lived the rock life with over 420 concerts under his belt and time spent as a stagehand running lights for local bands. A Harley rider with two jobs, Ray keeps it loud with Ratt, Megadeth, and Soundgarden while racking up wins and swag from The Bear since day one. Congrats, Ray – Real Rocker of the Day #184!

item.title: Real Rocker of the Day: Mason Haas of Osceola - Real Rocker #185 - 103.9 The Bear - Real Rock
item.description: Mason Haas from Osceola has been rocking with the JLNK Show for six straight years and hasn’t missed a single podcast episode. When he’s not out in nature or wrenching on his Volkswagen Rabbit and Honda Nighthawk, he’s cranking Blink-182, Linkin Park, and Shinedown. Congrats, Mason – Real Rocker of the Day #185!

item.title: Real Rocker of the Day: Nisa Morehouse of Mishawaka - Real Rocker #186 - 103.9 The Bear - Real Rock
item.description: Nisa Morehouse from Mishawaka rocks The Bear every single day with her kids right along for the ride. Working with School City of Mishawaka, she spends her free time hiking, biking, and making memories with her family—plus she’s hoping to take her kids to their first concert soon. Congrats, Nisa – Real Rocker of the Day #186!

item.title: Real Rocker of the Day: Samantha Rodriquez from Buchanan - Real Rocker #187 - 103.9 The Bear - Real Rock
item.description: Samantha “Sammie” Rodriquez from Buchanan has been rocking since before she was born—literally, thanks to a Def Leppard concert at Notre Dame and a drumstick from Rick Allen she still has today. A married mom of three who loves music, plants, and family, Sammie keeps it loud daily with The Bear and Lou Brutus. Congrats, Samantha – Real Rocker of the Day #187!

item.title: Real Rocker of the Day: Brian Ahern of South Bend - Real Rocker #188 - 103.9 The Bear - Real Rock
item.description: Brian Ahern from South Bend keeps the rock cranked all day long while working at Notre Dame’s aquatic center. A former Zamboni driver for 10 years, Brian runs on Metallica, Mudvayne, and Disturbed, and never misses a laugh with Jason Lee and Kluck on The Bear. Congrats, Brian – Real Rocker of the Day #188!

item.title: Real Rocker of the Day: Jake Craigo of South Bend - Real Rocker #189 - 103.9 The Bear - Real Rock
item.description: Jake Craigo from South Bend keeps it loud at Worldwide Jewelry and Pawn in Mishawaka, spending his days spinning records and jamming electric guitar. When he’s not working, he’s into horror films and hanging with his wife Mikala. With a playlist stacked from Tool to Iron Maiden, Jake lives for The Bear’s mix of rock and metal. Congrats, Jake – Real Rocker of the Day #189!

item.title: Real Rocker of the Day: Stephanie Matthews of Mishawaka - Real Rocker #190 - 103.9 The Bear - Real Rock
item.description: Stephanie Matthews from Mishawaka keeps it loud all day long—from The Jason Lee and Kluck Show to after work and even on the job at Community Wide FCU, surprising her coworkers with nonstop rock. A fan of everything from Linkin Park to AC/DC, she’s raising three teens on The Bear and living that chill, go-with-the-flow life. Congrats, Stephanie – Real Rocker of the Day #190!

item.title: Real Rocker of the Day: Ericka Castillo of Lake Station- Real Rocker #191 - 103.9 The Bear - Real Rock
item.description: Ericka Castillo from Lake Station brings the energy every day while working at Norfolk Southern Railroad in Chicago. When she’s not on the job, she’s chasing concerts with friends or getting outside whenever she can. Fueled by bands like Pantera, Halestorm, and Local H, The Bear is her go-to station. Congrats, Ericka – Real Rocker of the Day #191!
